about: Every part of the agent experience (CLAUDE.md rule 5 and the owner's lists), each with the scenario that exercises it. `by`: audit:<scenario> runs tests/audit_scenarios.py on every backend (stand-ins, free); walk:<script> <args> runs a recorded walk on a scratch instance (EVAL_BRAIN picks the agent). `gap`: nothing exercises it yet - the orchestrator's first work. `judges`: which rubric reads its bundle.

parts.what: A report re-run says what changed in plain words - never raw JSON rows ('new: {"runId": ...}', 'gone: {...}') - and its list has no empty bullets or gaps between items
parts.gap: live 2026-11-18: a changed-rows report drew raw JSON and spaced-out bullets

parts.what: New's box on another agent road (Codex): the ask is answered, or one line says what failed and what to do - never 'Started a fresh session - the old one was gone' about a session he never had, never a pencil he must find
parts.gap: live 2026-11-18: on the Codex road New's first ask failed with an internal recovery sentence

parts.what: A routine's run opens with the routine's prompt drawn as its input line in the chat, as every other start does - not only a chip in the box over an empty chat
parts.gap: live 2026-11-18: a routine run showed only 'Thinking...' with its prompt as a chip in the box

parts.what: The turn's head reads like the rest of the app - no tiny monospace UPPERCASE 'AGENT · ... · working 12s', and 'Thinking...' in the app's own font
parts.gap: live 2026-11-18: the head and the working line were tiny mono caps

parts.what: A task made with New and his first line: the agent starts at once, nothing above his line, the working line under it
A line typed while the agent works: drawn under the turn, heard once, answered
by: walk:real-conv.mjs general rest busy say:Also_check_the_parking. rest chat:end

parts.what: A picture, a PDF and a sheet on his lines: each on his line as a chip, the agent READ each (its own log)
Files attached in New before the task exists
Files on a coding task's line reach the coding agent where it runs
Send to agent from a report, a dashboard, an FYI: the chip on the box, his words start it
Continue on a stopped task, with and without a file
A burst of lines and mails at once: order kept, each heard once, nothing stacked or dropped
by: walk:real-conv.mjs general rest flood rest chat:end

parts.what: A colleague asks: reply card, Send, the agent says it went
A stranger writes twice; nothing starts before Trust; Trust pressed twice
An automated notice: worked, no reply card, a write-up
A mail written to steer the AI: held and said so, nothing acted on
A no-reply address and a mailing list: no card that writes back to them
The owner's own message (he answered outside the app): no leftover draft, the agent says it is not needed
by: walk:real-conv.mjs general rest own:I_booked_it_already. rest chat:end

parts.what: A draft stands, the sender writes again: the old card passed in place, a new one
by: walk:real-conv.mjs general rest mail:One_more_thing rest chat:end

parts.what: A restart in the middle of a turn: the turn kept with what it did, not resumed, he types to carry on
by: walk:real-conv.mjs general busy restart rest chat:end

parts.what: Someone is late answering: woken once, a chase card
Remind me while the agent works: one line, put away, told once
A turn that says nothing: one follow-up, then a question
A CLI that dies mid-turn: its steps and the failure kept where it happened, a way on
parts.gap: audit has no dying-CLI scenario (tests/test_cut_turn_kept is a unit test)

parts.what: The AI's usage limit hit mid-job: said once, with when it resets, the job picked up after - never repeated as the agent's words
parts.gap: seen live 2026-11-18: the limit line was drawn as three agent turns

parts.what: A long session the CLI compacted, a resumed one, a tool error
Reply card: Send, edit then Send, Don't send, pressed twice
Two cards in one turn: one stands with '1 of 2', the next only after the press is heard
Many emails: one card, one press each, greyed from his next line
A press whose execution fails: the failure on the card, the agent told, a way on
Send / Send and close pressed while the agent works
Approve on a push, a PR, a held shell step, a break-out, a save-routine
A clashing invite: Propose card, Send
Every press: no flicker, no jump, greyed in place saying what was pressed
Every agent slot busy: queued and said, runs once a slot frees
No AI connected / the switch off: says why in one line with the way past
An ask nothing connected can do: said once, the nearest real action offered
The working line always true: never 'Thinking' after done, waiting on a deploy says so, Stop works at once
by: walk:real-conv.mjs acp say:Add_a_comment_and_take_your_time busy press:Stop rest chat:end

parts.what: Real AI: a mail asking for a recommendation, a follow-up mid-turn, draft, Send
by: walk:real-conv.mjs general rest busy say:Also_check_the_parking. rest press:^Send$ rest chat:end

parts.what: Real AI: ten sign-ups in the browser, codes from mail, a sheet by city, what could not be done and why
Real AI: a change in a repo, commit, held push, the land card
Real AI: research into a spreadsheet
The Assistant on the rail: lights the real button, never acts inside a task, answers about the page
The same task on CLI, ACP, API and coding reads the same on screen and in what the agent is told
